'''Rod Latham Court of the Vile Gangster v2.0''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds101.htm Court of the Vile Gangster v2.0], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228054902/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds101.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
